items.zh: 我们心怀喜悦，看你升起。
items.en: With glowing hearts, we see you rise.

items.zh: 小石子变成长满青苔的巨石。
items.en: Little pebbles grow into moss-covered boulders.

items.zh: 交通系统暂时陷入瘫痪，
真的太神奇了，人工智能使许多不可能都变成了现实。
items.en: It is truly amazing that artificial intelligence has made the impossible possible.

items.zh: 一吃完晚饭，她就迫不及待地邀请我们去她家附近那条美丽的湖边散步。
items.en: On finishing dinner, she just couldn’t wait to invite us for a stroll along the beautiful lake near her home.
